sql:
SELECT
    RegionCountryName,
    CustomerKey,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    TotalSpend,
    CountryRank
FROM (
    SELECT
        g.RegionCountryName,
        c.CustomerKey,
        c.FirstName,
        c.LastName,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSpend,
        rank() OVER (PARTITION BY g.RegionCountryName ORDER BY sum(f.SalesAmount) DESC) AS CountryRank
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    JOIN retail.DimGeography g ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    GROUP BY g.RegionCountryName, c.CustomerKey, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
WHERE CountryRank <= 5
ORDER BY RegionCountryName, CountryRank
